title: 3.14 More Jobs
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Recognize six more jobs and say what someone's job is.
grammar_function: He/She is a/an + job. Is he a waiter? Yes, he is. Is she a mechanic? No, she is not.
prerequisite: 3.3 be forms, 3.4 yes/no questions and 3.9 jobs.
speaking_outcome: Say He is a waiter. and She is an artist.
